args.query: Fastify v4 to v5 migration: full JSON schema required for querystring and params, reply.redirect argument order changed, listen needs an options object

results.title: Fastify 5 OpenAPI docs generated with @fastify/swagger
results.summary: Generate an OpenAPI 3 document from Fastify 5 route schemas with @fastify/swagger, using shared $ref schemas, tags and security, then serve and check it with inject().

results.title: Fastify 5 routes with JSON Schema validation
results.summary: Fastify 5 route validation and response serialization with JSON Schema, tested via app.inject().

results.title: Fastify 5 + Zod 4 type provider for typed routes
results.summary: Use fastify-type-provider-zod so Zod 4 schemas validate requests, serialize responses and type handlers in Fastify 5.

results.title: Fastify 5 + @fastify/jwt protected routes
results.summary: Sign and verify JWTs in Fastify 5 with @fastify/jwt and an authenticate preHandler that guards routes.

results.title: Fastify 5 file uploads with @fastify/multipart
results.summary: Accept multipart file uploads in Fastify 5 with @fastify/multipart, reading fields and files, hashing content, rejecting oversized files with 413, tested with inject() and a native FormData body.

results.title: Generate TypeScript types from JSON Schema with json-schema-to-typescript
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas into TypeScript interfaces with json-schema-to-typescript, covering required and optional fields, enums, $ref definitions, descriptions as JSDoc and strict additionalProperties.

results.title: Zod v4 schemas exported to JSON Schema and checked with Ajv
results.summary: Export Zod v4 schemas to JSON Schema 2020-12 with z.toJSONSchema, using .meta() ids and descriptions and input vs output modes, then validate the same data with Ajv 2020.

results.title: AJV 8 JSON Schema validation with ajv-formats
results.summary: Compile JSON Schema drafts with AJV 8, enable email/uri/uuid formats via ajv-formats, and return field errors from validate.errors for API payloads.

results.title: Orama full-text search over in-memory documents
results.summary: Create an @orama/orama schema, insert documents, and run full-text search with term matching offline.

results.title: voluptuous config schemas with Coerce, All, Range and Required
results.summary: Validate and coerce stringly-typed config into a typed dict with voluptuous, combining Coerce, All, Range, In and Required, and testing the failure paths offline.
